text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 188 Royal York Road to maintain a rear yard fence constructed of metal panels, which does not meet all of the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption submitted by the property owner of 188 Royal York Road, without conditions, thereby allowing a rear yard fence constructed of metal panels to be maintained in good repair. Directed and require that the rear yard fence be maintained in good repair without alteration. Directed and require that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, such installations will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
